product_overview: Neptune EHS is a multi-module environmental, health, and safety web platform for managing incidents, hazards, audits, compliance tasks, documents, and corrective actions. It also includes HazCom, PPE, LOTO, and related safety operations, with dashboards and administrative RBAC controls for tenant-based organizations.
core_goals: Authenticate into the workspace and access a role-based EHS command center
Report and manage incidents from creation through closure
Track near misses and hazards, including conversion into incidents
Run audits and inspections using templates, checklists, and findings
Manage corrective and preventive actions linked to incidents and other records
Maintain safety documents, acknowledgments, and policy approvals
Manage HazCom chemicals, SDS files, and GHS label generation
Support PPE and LOTO workflows that rely on shared certification gating
View dashboards, registers, and analytics for operational oversight

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows users to sign in with email and password and access the authenticated workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit sign-in form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit sign-in form -> See an inline validation error
Navigate to /login -> Choose the password reset path -> Reach the reset-password flow
Navigate to /login -> Choose the account creation path -> Reach the signup flow

features.name: Account Signup and Onboarding
features.description: Guides new users through account creation and workspace setup before entering the product.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter full name, email, password, and confirmation -> Accept terms and conditions -> Observe password strength feedback -> Complete account creation -> Continue to onboarding
Navigate to /signup -> Enter mismatched passwords -> Submit signup form -> See a passwords-do-not-match validation error
Navigate to /onboarding -> Enter organization details -> Add one or more sites -> Select enabled modules -> Move through the setup steps -> Submit registration -> Enter the workspace

features.name: Password Reset
features.description: Lets users request a password reset code and set a new password.
user_flows: Navigate to /forget-password -> Enter email address -> Request reset code -> Move to the reset-password flow
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter OTP and new password -> Submit reset form -> Return to successful account access flow
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter a weak new password -> Submit reset form -> See a password validation error

features.name: EHS Command Center Dashboard
features.description: Provides the main post-login landing page with KPI cards, incident trends, and action shortcuts.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Wait for KPI cards to load -> Review cross-module metrics -> Switch site context -> Open a linked item from My Actions
Navigate to /dashboard -> Use the sidebar navigation -> Move into another module area

features.name: Incident Reporting
features.description: Supports creation of a new incident through a structured multi-step reporting wizard.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/incidents/report-incident -> Pick a severity level -> Enter incident date, time, location, reporter, and description -> Add photos -> Add injured person details and select affected body parts -> Record response actions -> Review the summary -> Submit the incident
Navigate to /dashboard/incidents/report-incident -> Leave required fields empty -> Attempt to continue -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /dashboard/incidents/report-incident -> Fill in the description -> Use AI assistance to rewrite it -> Continue through the wizard -> Submit the incident

features.name: Incident Register and Detail Management
features.description: Lets users search, filter, open, edit, and close incident records with related tabs and attachments.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/incidents/list -> Search incidents -> Apply severity and disposition filters -> Page through results -> Open an incident record

Navigate to /dashboard/incidents/[id] -> Switch between detail tabs -> Edit incident details -> Save changes -> Add a timeline entry -> Upload an attachment -> Add witnesses and notified people -> Review linked CAPA information
Navigate to /dashboard/incidents/[id] -> Complete closure steps -> Submit closure -> See the incident status change

features.name: Near Miss Management
features.description: Supports reporting, reviewing, closing, and converting near misses into incidents.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/near-miss -> Search or filter near misses -> Open a near miss record -> Review details -> Close the record
Navigate to /dashboard/near-miss/[id] -> Choose conversion to incident -> Review the pre-populated incident data -> Submit conversion -> Open the resulting incident

features.name: Hazard Management
features.description: Allows users to report hazards, review their workflow state, and edit existing records.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/hazard -> Report a new hazard -> Enter hazard details -> Submit the report
Navigate to /dashboard/hazard -> Filter hazards by category and status -> Open a hazard record -> Advance its workflow state
Navigate to /dashboard/hazard/[id]/edit -> Update hazard details -> Save the changes

features.name: CAPA Management
features.description: Manages corrective and preventive actions linked to incidents and other records.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/capa -> Review the CAPA register -> Open a CAPA record
Navigate to /dashboard/incidents/[id] -> Add a CAPA from the incident -> Complete the CAPA creation flow -> Return to the linked incident
Navigate to /dashboard/capa -> Select hierarchy of controls and control type -> Drop or close a CAPA

features.name: Audit Templates and Execution
features.description: Enables users to create audit templates and run audits or inspections from published templates.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/audits/template/create -> Add sections and checklist items -> Configure scoring logic -> Publish the template
Navigate to /dashboard/audits/start -> Select a published template -> Start the audit -> Complete checklist responses -> Review findings -> Export the report to PDF
Navigate to /dashboard/audits/checklist -> Work through checklist responses -> Review section outcomes and findings

features.name: Inspection Templates and Execution
features.description: Supports inspection template creation and execution using the inspection workflow.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/inspections/template/create -> Add template sections and items -> Publish the template
Navigate to /dashboard/inspections -> Start an inspection from a template -> Complete the checklist -> Review findings and report

features.name: HazCom Chemical Inventory
features.description: Lets users create, search, publish, and edit chemical inventory records with GHS data.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/hazcom/chemicals/new -> Enter chemical details including name, CAS number, and GHS codes -> Save the record as a draft
Navigate to /dashboard/hazcom/chemicals -> Search the chemical list -> Open an existing chemical -> Edit and save it
Navigate to /dashboard/hazcom/chemicals -> Review draft and published records -> Publish a previously saved chemical

features.name: HazCom SDS Library
features.description: Provides a searchable SDS library with document upload and in-app viewing.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/hazcom/sds/upload -> Upload an SDS file -> Save the document to the library
Navigate to /dashboard/hazcom/sds -> Search the SDS library -> Open an SDS -> Browse its sections in the viewer

features.name: HazCom Risk Assessments and Training
features.description: Supports creation of chemical risk assessments and HazCom training records.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/hazcom/risk-assessments/new -> Create a risk assessment -> Choose a hazard rating -> Save the assessment
Navigate to /dashboard/hazcom/training/new -> Create a training record -> Assign attendees -> Save the training entry

features.name: Policy Maker Documents
features.description: Lets users upload policy documents, manage versions, approve documents, and record acknowledgments.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/policy-maker/upload -> Upload a policy document -> Assign category and department -> Save the document
Navigate to /dashboard/policy-maker -> Open a document -> View its versions -> Approve the document -> Publish it
Navigate to /dashboard/policy-maker/[id]/acknowledge -> Acknowledge the policy document -> Review the acknowledgment list

known_limitations.issue: No server-side or middleware auth guard on any protected route
known_limitations.impact: GET /dashboard returns HTTP 200 with full shell markup to an unauthenticated client. The only guard is a client useEffect that redirects after hydration, so protected routes flash before redirecting. Tests asserting a redirect must wait for hydration, not for the HTTP response.

known_limitations.issue: Access and refresh tokens are stored in localStorage
known_limitations.impact: Tokens are readable by any script on the origin and survive tab close. No httpOnly cookie option.

known_limitations.issue: The signup password is written to localStorage in plaintext
known_limitations.location: src/lib/signup-storage.ts line 84, called from src/components/auth/SignupRightPanel.tsx line 62
known_limitations.impact: The raw password persists under the neptune-signup key across the onboarding flow and is restored into the form on revisit. It is only removed if clearSignupState runs.

known_limitations.issue: Continue With Google performs no authentication
known_limitations.impact: The button calls router.push('/onboarding') directly, letting anyone skip account creation and enter onboarding with no credentials captured.

known_limitations.issue: Signup form schema and register request schema disagree on field limits
known_limitations.impact: registerRequestSchema caps fullName and email at 50 characters but signupFormSchema has no max, so an over-long value passes signup and only fails later at registration.

known_limitations.issue: Create account button is disabled solely by password strength with no explanation
known_limitations.impact: With an empty or weak password the submit button is disabled and no message says why, so the form appears unresponsive.

known_limitations.issue: Stale form error is only cleared when the confirm password field changes
known_limitations.impact: Correcting an invalid email leaves the previous error text on screen.

known_limitations.issue: Nine dashboard modules are static mockups with no API calls
known_limitations.impact: These routes render fixed markup. End-to-end assertions about creating or persisting data there will be meaningless; only render and navigation checks are valid.

known_limitations.issue: Design tokens are widely bypassed by hardcoded hex colors
known_limitations.location: 740 hex literals across 121 tsx files, concentrated in src/components/incidents/detail and src/components/incidents/shared/capa

known_limitations.issue: 150 raw button elements bypass the shared Button component
known_limitations.impact: Focus ring, disabled state and hover treatment are inconsistent with ehsButtonBaseClass, which affects keyboard accessibility assertions.

known_limitations.issue: The app proxies all API traffic to a shared staging backend
known_limitations.impact: Any create/update/delete performed during a test writes real records to https://neptune-be-stag.codeswift.org that other users can see.
